# Quality & Security Requirements Checklist: Planejador de Aulas BNCC

**Purpose**: Review and validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and testability of requirements focusing on Privacy, Authentication, n8n Integration, Failure States, and Accessibility.
**Created**: 2026-10-02  
**Feature**: [`spec.md`](../spec.md) | [`plan.md`](../plan.md) | [`contracts/n8n-integration.md`](../contracts/n8n-integration.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

---

## 1. Privacidade e Isolamento Docente (Privacy & Tenant Isolation)

- [ ] CHK001 Is the HTTP 404 response requirement explicitly defined for all unauthorized resource access attempts (GET, PUT, DELETE, POST sub-resources) to prevent IDOR and resource enumeration? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Clarifications Session]
- [ ] CHK002 Does the specification explicitly define that error responses for unauthorized plan requests must not disclose whether the plan ID exists in the database? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are data filtering requirements specified to ensure that draft listing queries automatically scope to the authenticated `userId` without client-provided overrides? [Consistency, Spec §FR-019, Constitution §III]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the isolation between demonstration accounts (`ana@demo.bncc.br` and `marcos@demo.bncc.br`) defined with objective, testable boundary criteria across the entire plan lifecycle? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements documented regarding logging and telemetry hygiene to ensure teacher prompt instructions or draft content do not leak into unencrypted server logs? [Coverage, Gap, Constitution §VIII]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the specification strictly define that n8n webhook endpoints and API keys must never be exposed or transmitted to the web client? [Completeness, Constitution §II, Plan §Technical Context]

---

## 2. Autenticação, Gestão de Sessão e Proteção de Segredos (Authentication & Session)

- [ ] CHK007 Is the Access Token storage requirement unambiguously specified as in-memory on the frontend, explicitly prohibiting localStorage or sessionStorage? [Clarity, Plan §Technical Context, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK008 Are cookie configuration requirements (`HttpOnly: true`, `SameSite: Strict`, `Path: /api/auth`, and conditional `Secure` flag for production vs localhost) explicitly documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK009 Are cryptographic hashing requirements defined for stored credentials, specifically specifying bcrypt for passwords and SHA-256 for refresh tokens? [Clarity, Data Model §2, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the session duration quantified with precise expiration values (8-hour maximum session, 15-minute access token) and rotation semantics upon token refresh? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios US1]
- [ ] CHK011 Are CSRF protection requirements specified for cookie-based state-changing requests (such as custom header validation)? [Coverage, Research §4, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK012 Does the specification clarify the exact UX requirement when a session expires mid-edit (e.g., alert prompt, preservation of unsaved buffer, redirect to login)? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases]

---

## 3. Contrato e Integração com n8n (n8n Webhook & Payload Contracts)

- [ ] CHK013 Are request payload field schemas (`sessao`, `habilidade`, `instrucao`, `duracao`, `recursos_digitais`) strictly defined and aligned with the provider reference in `docs/contracts/n8n.md`? [Consistency, Contract §n8n-integration, docs/contracts/n8n.md]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the serialization format for combining 1 to 3 selected BNCC skills into the single `habilidade` string field unambiguously specified with delimiter rules? [Clarity, Contract §n8n-integration §2, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Are response payload validation requirements specified with strict schema checks (`success: true`, `sessao`, `habilidade`, `answer`, `format: "markdown"`) rejecting malformed responses? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §n8n-integration §3]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the request timeout quantified with a strict threshold (exactly 45 seconds via AbortSignal) without ambiguous tolerances? [Measurability, Spec §FR-011, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK017 Does the specification explicitly prohibit automatic retries on AI call failures, mandating that retries only occur via voluntary user action? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Contract §n8n-integration §1]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for a local mock mode (`N8N_MOCK_ENABLED=true`) to enable deterministic testing without consuming live workflow credits? [Coverage, Plan §Constitution Check, Quickstart §2]
- [ ] CHK019 Is HTTP header authentication (`x-api-key`) and traceability tracking (`x-request-id`) explicitly required for all outgoing n8n requests? [Completeness, Contract §n8n-integration §1]

---

## 4. Estados de Falha, Resiliência e Atomicidade (Failure States & Atomicity)

- [ ] CHK020 Are database atomicity requirements defined so that on AI failure, timeout, or schema rejection, no partial Plan record is persisted in the database? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the state machine lifecycle of `AiRun` (`PENDING` -> `SUCCEEDED` / `FAILED`) and its single-transaction link to `Plan` creation unambiguously documented? [Clarity, Data Model §1, Plan §Technical Context]
- [ ] CHK022 Are form retention requirements specified so that 100% of user inputs (skills, prompt instruction, duration, digital resource flag) remain intact after generation errors? [Measurability, Spec §FR-014, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the UI loading state requirement defined with action-blocking semantics to prevent concurrent or duplicate submissions during the 45-second window? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Spec §Acceptance Scenarios US3]
- [ ] CHK024 Does the specification define user-facing error message requirements, ensuring technical stack traces or upstream gateway error codes are abstracted into actionable guidance? [Clarity, Constitution §Technical Context, Spec §US3]
- [ ] CHK025 Are exit-confirmation requirements defined to intercept navigation events when unpersisted changes exist in the Markdown editor? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018, Figma Frame 09]

---

## 5. Acessibilidade (WCAG 2.1 AA) e Estados de Interface (Accessibility & UI Ergonomics)

- [ ] CHK026 Are color contrast requirements quantified to meet or exceed WCAG 2.1 AA ratios (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text and UI components) against Figma DS tokens? [Measurability, Spec §FR-022, Constitution §VII]
- [ ] CHK027 Are keyboard navigation requirements defined for all interactive elements (form inputs, skill removal tags, editor toolbar, split/tab toggles, dialog buttons)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-022, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK028 Are visible focus indicator requirements specified for custom inputs, checkboxes, and buttons without relying solely on default browser outlines? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022, Figma 2:11440]
- [ ] CHK029 Are ARIA live region requirements (`aria-live="polite"` or `role="status"`) specified for asynchronous state changes (loading indicator, error banner, save notification)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK030 Are focus trap and focus restoration requirements defined for the unsaved changes confirmation modal? [Coverage, Edge Case, Figma Frame 09]
- [ ] CHK031 Are responsive layout adaptation requirements specified between desktop (split view side-by-side) and mobile/tablet (toggle tabs) with parity of editing capabilities? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016, Clarifications Session]
- [ ] CHK032 Are HTML sanitization requirements specified for the Markdown preview renderer to strictly disallow arbitrary script execution and unsafe HTML tags? [Completeness, Plan §Technical Context, Research §7]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline.
- Link to relevant resources or documentation.
- Items are numbered sequentially (`CHK001` to `CHK032`) for easy reference and auditability.
